status: MODEL, 2026-11-02. Not a measurement record: values are copied from the data/raw files named in each block's provenance by data/raw/2026-11-02_sim/make_rig_geometry.py. Change the sources or the generator, or edit by hand and say so in the provenance.

frame.axes: x lateral (+ = right as seen from the camera), y depth behind the #3 front plane (+ = into the shelf), z height above the top of #3's floor board (the mug shelf). Right-handed.
frame.origin: #3 front plane, on the #3 centre line, at the mug-shelf top
frame.from_analytic: analytic design frame (geom_measured.py, geom_far.py; cm): x_a lateral, y_a height, z_a depth behind the front plane. sim (x, y, z) = (x_a, z_a, y_a) / 100
frame.from_positions_draft: floor_coords_cm lateral_cm -> x, out_from_front_cm -> -y, height_cm -> z (lens above the #3 floor top), heading_deg_right + = turned toward +x, tilt_deg = pitch down

camera.model: pinhole, square pixels, principal point at the image centre (W/2, H/2); continuous pixel coordinates with pixel i covering [i, i + 1)
camera.k1_note: radial term of the far pose fit (x_d = x (1 + k1 r^2) on normalised coordinates). MuJoCo renders a pinhole and ignores it; sim/rig.py applies it only when asked (frame checks).
camera.p3_fit_note: the real P3 camera as fitted on far_p3.jpg (before the 2026-10-10 bump); heading + = turned right (toward +x), roll in pose_fit_far.py's sign (reproduces pixel_budget.json corners, geom_far_selftest.txt)
